repairs_this_round.R1: The multipart episode directory is a frozen constant `Season 01` in MediaPackageLayoutPolicy instead of being derived from the declared entries. Deriving it let the input define its own template, so a package whose episode entries all agreed on `Season 99/`, or on no season directory at all, was accepted. Both are now refused per entry, and the tests prove all-episodes-moved and no-season-directory cases in ContractTests and BoundaryTests.
repairs_this_round.R2: MediaPackagePathBoundary gained TryObserveDirectory, which separates 'is a directory', 'is a regular file' and 'cannot be observed', because Directory.Exists returns false for both 'a file is here' and 'nothing is here'. IsolatedMediaPackageInspector now calls RequireTargetParentDirectory before the first read and again at the final confirmation: a regular file is unsafe_path and is never disguised as target_exists, a missing root stays target_unavailable.
repairs_this_round.R3: The hand-written raw-byte escape scan was removed. It missed `\uD800XDC00` because it did not require the low half to start with `\u`, and it mis-rejected the legal pair `\uD83D\uDE00`. MediaPackageManifestReader now forces the JSON reader to decode every property name and every string value, so a lone surrogate half is invalid_manifest@surrogate_escape in a value, a path and a key alike, while a legal pair and the same character written as UTF-8 behave identically. No new JSON parser, no new file, no blanket catch, no echoed exception text.
repairs_this_round.R4: MediaPackageIssueSink.Record consults the bounded de-duplication set before the cap, so repeating an already-reported pair no longer sets IsTruncated: only a genuinely new, distinct problem dropped for capacity does. The public MediaPackageObservedFile port is reverted to its original shape; the (length, last-write) stamp now lives in the Inspector's own private ObservedFile record, so no internal bookkeeping leaks into a published contract.
repairs_this_round.R5: The six test constructions and assertions the coordinator's real run failed were corrected, all of them on the test side: a real second case-folding entry in the duplicate-path boundary test, an assertion that accepts OperationCanceledException and its derived TaskCanceledException while still proving cancellation, ResolveCalls == 0 for the over-budget manifest (the budget is decided before authorization), the sum of all payloads as the read-budget basis in both budget tests, and no forced IssuesTruncated for the enumeration-cap stop. The refusal assertion for the target root replaced by a file is kept verbatim and now passes because of the R2 product fix.
repairs_this_round.R6: The six tracking documents were rewritten against this round's real code and real evidence: the fixed Season 01 contract, the real parse-budget-before-authorization order, the real changed-file counts, the real test changes, expired-to-scope_changed, IssueSink no longer described as unchanged, and the historical errors marked as corrected. No unauthorised design and no exemption that was never granted is written as done.

technical_debt: MediaPackageLayoutPolicy compares complete paths against the frozen templates with `Season 01` as a compile-time constant, and refuses a duplicate role per part, instead of the previous basename-only match or the second round's input-derived directory.

IsolatedMediaPackageInspector retains each observed file's length and last-write stamp in a private record and re-observes the target and its trusted parent at the end of the run, so a same-size rewrite and a target root replaced by a file are both refused rather than reported as inspected.

MediaPackageManifestReader decides string well-formedness by making the JSON reader decode every property name and string value; a decode failure becomes invalid_manifest@surrogate_escape and the framework exception is discarded.

MediaPackageIssueSink is bounded, deduplicates before the cap and hands out read-only views, so a hostile or pathological input can neither grow the report, inflate the truncation flag, nor mutate it back.
MaximumEnumeratedEntries (4096) remains a constant rather than a configurable limit, so an oversized staging directory fails with budget_exceeded instead of a tuned path.
Several CA1506 suppressions carry written justifications; they can be reclaimed once a composition root exists.
